C. A. 5th Cir. Motion of petitioner for leave to proceed in forma pauperis and certiorari granted. Judgment vacated and case remanded to the *807Court of Appeals for further proceedings, including, if appropriate, the reentry of its judgment affirming petitioner’s conviction and appointment .of counsel to assist petitioner in seeking timely review of that judgment in this Court.

Justice Rehnquist dissents.
